decision.observation: 9 mph, gear R, red X lit, 5 dots blue. The car has backed a long way and now sits on grass just right of the white two-storey house with the grey roof; the gravel road curves past up-frame, with the white paddock fence and cows beyond it.
decision.hypothesis: The long reverse carried the car past the road entirely to the house side. Reversing further risks hitting the house, so the next step is a plain-W conversion, to see which way the nose ends up facing before adding steer.
decision.memory: A 1.2 s S+A from 3 mph turned into a huge positional change (~3-4 car lengths plus a camera cut) - reverse speed compounds faster than forward gains. When reverse exceeds ~8 mph near buildings, stop reversing immediately; the white two-storey house is a solid obstacle.
